# Performance Report — FPT University HCMC 3D Digital Twin

## Measured Asset Metrics (Generated by Blender 5.2.1 LTS)
| Asset | File Size | Triangles | Meshes (Draw Calls) | Target Tier |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| `public/models/fpt-campus.glb` | **7.47 MB** (7,830,560 bytes) | **108,296** | **38** | HIGH (Desktop) / MEDIUM (Laptop) |
| `public/models/fpt-campus-low.glb` | **6.41 MB** (6,722,916 bytes) | **96,620** | **38** | LOW (Mobile) |
| `assets/blender/fpt-campus.blend` | Editable Blender source | 108,296 | 38 + 3 scan targets | Authoring |

## Optimization Techniques Implemented
1. **Material/Layer BMesh Batching**: All repeated architectural slabs, windows, mullions, balconies, planters, pathways, and trees are batched into 38 merged meshes grouped by `(semantic_layer, material_role)` instead of thousands of separate scene graph nodes.
2. **Three Runtime Quality Tiers**:
   - **HIGH (Desktop)**: `fpt-campus.glb`, `antialias: true`, `DPR <= 2`, `2048×2048` `PCFSoftShadowMap`.
   - **MEDIUM (Laptop)**: `fpt-campus.glb`, `antialias: true`, `DPR <= 1.5`, `1024×1024` `PCFSoftShadowMap`.
   - **LOW (Mobile)**: `fpt-campus-low.glb`, `antialias: false`, `DPR <= 1`, dynamic shadows disabled.
3. **Zero Per-Frame Allocations**: Scratch `THREE.Vector3` instances are pre-allocated outside `requestAnimationFrame`; React HUD progress sync is throttled to ~4 Hz.
4. **Viewport Lifecycle Hygiene**: `IntersectionObserver` pauses rendering when offscreen; `document.hidden` pauses background tabs; full GPU resource disposal runs on unmount/quality switch.

## Known Limitations
- **Draco/KTX2**: Standard uncompressed GLB was exported so `GLTFLoader` works out-of-the-box without external CDN/WASM decoder dependencies (`7.47 MB < 10 MB` target). If further size reduction (~1–2 MB) is desired later, `use_draco=True` in `scripts/generate_fpt_campus.py` can be enabled alongside a local `public/draco/` decoder.
- **Architectural Accuracy**: Dimensions and floor counts (6 / 8 / 11 peaks) are visual approximations based on public VTN Architects / FPT University HCMC references rather than surveyed CAD drawings.
- **Runtime FPS**: 60 FPS (desktop) / 30 FPS (mobile) are design optimization targets; actual FPS depends on client GPU hardware.
